name_en: WQ101 Alpha99 Mid ADV Low Volume Gate
name_zh: WQ101 Alpha99 中价均量低价成交门控
formula_zh: -1*(rank(中价和与adv60和相关) < rank(最低价与成交量相关))
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 87h bars.

expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction intentionally left conditional to avoid post-hoc fitting. Empirical diagnostics required.

known_limitations_en: Boolean mid-ADV versus low-volume correlation gate can be highly redundant with volume/liquidity families.
